scope: Development-only fixed-protein proxy mechanism and common-input actual-set evaluation of internal multistart initialization. No external sequence is used by any new arm. No functional, untouched, generator-training, time-matched, or external-SOTA claim.
observed_before_new_outcomes: RK39 raw random-initialized hill-climbing lost to LinearDesign-11 on both common-input actual-set endpoints. RK40 showed positive short-budget normalization and budget effects and a much larger external-seeded initialization diagnostic. No RK41 initialization-pool outcomes have been generated or read.
population: The same 18 development records as RK39/RK40; no untouched24, functional untouched, MAGE test, Ribo test, or assay labels.
accepted_baseline_rule: Reuse the 108 independently verified RK40 B11 runs by exact record/seed/arm/path/SHA identity; no outcome-based selection or regeneration.

initialization_pool.construction: Pool member 0 is exactly RK39 protein_only_initial(source,seed). Continue with candidate seeds seed+1000, seed+2000, ... until eight distinct legal synonymous DNA sequences are obtained. Native CDS is used only to translate the protein and is then discarded; terminal TAA is fixed. No LinearDesign, EnsembleDesign, native synonymous, or other external DNA sequence enters any new arm.
initialization_pool.first_rule: Select pool index 0; this is the matched-pool control.
initialization_pool.best_rule: Select the pool member with maximum search weighted utility before local search, with the lowest index breaking ties. Raw arms use unnormalized objectives; calibrated arms use frozen native-development normalization.
initialization_pool.shared_cache: All eight pool members are real scored outputs. The selected start is a cache hit, and only three further unique synonymous proposals are needed to reach exactly eleven unique-scorer outputs. Duplicate proposals are cache hits and never consume budget.
initialization_pool.rationale: Eight starts plus three local unique proposals were fixed before outcomes to make initialization allocation detectable within the original eleven-call budget; the first/best arms share the same pool and local-search RNG seed.

normalization.raw: No normalization is used for pool selection or local hill-climbing; native calibration is read only after all eleven sequences are fixed. Raw pool arms preserve common-input semantics.
normalization.calibrated: Frozen native-development calibration is read before pool selection and local search; calibrated arms are interaction diagnostics and not common-input evidence.
normalization.evaluation: Every internal and LinearDesign actual point is evaluated with the same frozen per-record calibration after sequence generation.

endpoint_definitions.best_normalized_weighted_utility: Maximum over all eleven real unique points of dot((objectives-reference)/scale,weights); one sequence contributes once.
endpoint_definitions.best_single_point_normalized_hv: Maximum over all eleven real unique points of prod(max((objectives-reference)/scale,0)); no multi-sequence archive advantage.
endpoint_definitions.first_k_hv: Normalized actual-set hypervolume of the first k real unique outputs, where k is the record-specific LinearDesign-11 actual unique-DNA cardinality frozen in RK39; no best-k, zero filling, or dense inference.
endpoint_definitions.first_k_ned: Pairwise normalized edit distance of the same first-k real unique outputs.

primary_families.question: Within the identical raw eight-member pool and eleven-call budget, does utility-selected initialization outperform first-member initialization after local search?
Does the internal best-of-eight multistart allocation outperform the original raw sequential eleven-call hill-climb?
Does the new internal raw design outperform the real LinearDesign-11 actual set under the same fixed protein, fixed TAA, common post-hoc calibration, and record-specific first-k cardinality?

statistics.unit: one record; arithmetic mean of its three seeds before paired inference
statistics.ci_method: two-sided percentile paired bootstrap of record-level mean effects
statistics.p_value: two-sided paired sign-flip with plus-one correction, capped at 1
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over the two endpoints within each of the three independently named primary families
statistics.family_success_rule: Both endpoints require 95% CI lower bound >0, family-Holm p<0.05, and positive mean effects for every individual seed; otherwise that family is not supported.

diagnostics: calibrated_pool_best_b11 minus calibrated_pool_first_b11 on best-single endpoints
calibrated_pool_best_b11 minus calibrated_random_b11 on best-single endpoints
calibrated_pool_best_b11 minus raw_pool_best_b11 on best-single endpoints
raw_pool_best_b11 minus LinearDesign-11 on best-single endpoints, descriptive only
raw_pool_best_b11 minus raw_pool_first_b11 on matched-first-k actual-set HV/NED
Initial selected-point utility/HV, full eleven-point actual-set metrics, and dense internal anytime AUC are descriptive; external dense remains null

execution.order: benchmark FASTA order, then seed ascending, then protocol new-arm order
execution.resume: skip only completed run JSON with matching protocol/code/input/pool/selection/budget identity; never accept partial output

allowed_conclusion: A development-only fixed-protein proxy evaluation of internal multistart selection under a shared eleven-unique-scorer budget, plus a limited common-input actual-set comparison with LinearDesign-11. Positive internal or external contrasts do not establish universal mechanism, functional efficacy, or external SOTA.
forbidden_conclusion: No external-sequence attribution to CodonFlow, unified time-matched ranking, complete seven-method dense matrix, functional or protein-OOD claim, untouched generalization, generator improvement, RK-G1 closure, or manuscript-submittable claim.
